record.question: Calculate the standard Licence fee for a Government residential building occupied by a Government Officer from the following data: Cost of land 25000, Cost of Preparation of site 3000, Cost of building 50000, Cost of fencing 1500, Cost of attached garage 3500, Electric Installation 2000, Water installation 1400, Rate of Interest 4%, Rate of ordinary and special repairs 1½%, Municipal Tax 1200 p.a, Tools and plant charged direct to work but not included in any of the above 1300. Work out the licence fee payable by the officer occupying the above building for November 2017 from the following particulars: Pay Rs. 25050, Grade Pay Rs.7600, Special Pay Rs. 550, Dearness allowance 139% of Pay + GP = Rs. 45384, Non Recurring Fee Rs. 500, The prescribed flat rate licence fee of the building is Rs. 1099 pm.
